# awscc_apiportal_managed_api (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::ManagedApi



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `api_signature` (Attributes) Identifies a discovered API by its source resource, method, hostname, port, and path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_signature))
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the managed API was created.
- `managed_api_arn` (String) The ARN of the managed API.
- `managed_api_id` (String) The managed API identifier.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the managed API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the managed API was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--api_signature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_signature`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The front-door hostname of the API.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method of the API.
- `path` (String) The route path of the API.
- `port` (Number) The port the API is served on.
- `resource_arn` (String) ARN of the source-service resource (API Gateway stage, load balancer, or CloudFront distribution).


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
